name: Tai-Kuras
source:
Tai-Kuras tends to speak in surzhyk (a mix of Ukrainian and Russian; speaks a mix of English & German in English version). Tai-Kuras adores literature, especially in the horror genre, which is why he lives in a library. Tai-Kuras enjoys being served and enslaves those who lose to him in battle.

Tai-Kuras may suffer from a God complex, as indicated by his desire to have servants and his view of himself as “the greates.” However, this does not prevent him from serving Beexen and Tai-Anara.

Tai-Kuras emerged from Beexen’s heart as the personification of her vanity — her belief in her own exceptional nature. By the beginning of the game’s events, he resides in a grand library alongside his servant, Yorick, where they lure unsuspecting victims into their trap.
